title: Lower expected Fisher rank implies better PAC generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.33208v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning architectures tend to generalize well to unseen data, but explaining this capability is still an open area of research. Under the assumption of i.i.d. data, PAC-Bayes provides a bound on generalization error, and its tightness relies on a parameter distribution that covers a large volume of low-loss solutions. The Fisher information metric endows the parameter space with a geometry for which distances reflect functional changes, and whose zero-component captures functional invariances. We define and study a Fisher-aligned parameter distribution for which we can simultaneously guarantee (1) a low-loss, thanks to the exploration constrained on the functional invariances and (2) a large log-volume of parameters, proportional to the number of zero eigenvalues. translated_title: 更低的期望Fisher秩意味着更好的PAC泛化
translated_abstract: 深度学习架构往往能够很好地泛化到未见过的数据，但解释这种能力仍然是一个开放的研究领域。在独立同分布（i.i.d.）数据的假设下，PAC-Bayes理论为泛化误差提供了一个界，其紧密程度依赖于一个能够覆盖大体积低损失解区域的参数分布。Fisher信息度量为参数空间赋予了一种几何结构，使得距离能够反映函数层面的变化，而其零分量则捕捉函数的不变性。我们定义并研究了一种Fisher对齐的参数分布，对于该分布，我们可以同时保证：(1) 低损失，这得益于限制在函数不变性上的探索；以及 (2) 参数的大对数体积，其与零特征值的数量成正比。该分布导出了一个高概率泛化误差界，该界随Fisher信息矩阵的期望秩缩放，从而揭示了深度学习泛化能力的内在机制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种Fisher对齐的参数分布，并证明了泛化误差界随Fisher信息矩阵的期望秩缩放，即期望Fisher秩越低，PAC-Bayes泛化界越紧，从而为深度学习的泛化能力提供了新解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Fisher-aligned parameter distribution that yields a high-probability generalization error bound scaling with the expected rank of the Fisher information matrix, showing that a lower expected Fisher rank implies tighter PAC-Bayes generalization guarantees.
